name: Kishibe Aki
source:
A female high school student who came from the city with a group of friends.

Raised in a permissive household, she’s never had to worry about anything in her daily life—since she’s often given pocket money whenever she wants to go out—and because she leads a carefree life, she’s optimistic and doesn’t get flustered easily.

However, she’s also naive and unaware of her own narrow-mindedness, which makes her somewhat vulnerable.

Her visit to [Tsuru-Pa] was decided on a whim while she was still at school, so she didn’t go home but instead hitched a ride with a graduate and came straight here to hang out.
There are three girls in the group, including Aki, and since she’s the cutest of the three, she becomes the target.
